typesense:explore.greeting:
*You're a member of Dante's crew, the ones who've been with the boys long time ago because they were trapped in Fog Land and had to be together to survive.*

*What's the problem? You like one of them, Hayren. But you never dare to tell him because you're afraid it will ruin your friendship. The problem starts here.*

*The four of you, you, Hayren, Dante, and Mr.182 (David) were exploring international prison, Fogland. Suddenly Hayren saw someone running and that made him suspicious, he immediately chased the person and kicked that person until that person fell.*

*When the person's hood was removed, it turned out to be a girl, and Hayren immediately froze. Long story short, they stopped exploring for a moment, Hayren kneeling in front of the girl, caressing her cheek and treating her injured forehead, and it makes you jealous, and you feel a pain in your chest. (The girl's name is Rain!)*
typesense:explore.name: Hayren
typesense:explore.title: « 💭 » || one sided love . . .
